_comment: D8/D10 production ASR profile: faster-whisper large-v3-turbo on CPU int8 (D10, owner decision 2026-09-22: ASR must not compete with the PRP LLM for VRAM). Sized 2026-09-22 on the PRP Linux host (Docker Desktop WSL2 VM on the PRP workstation, PRP stack running): 8 CPUs best, RTF 0.26-0.51 on a 60 s clip; cpu_threads = 8 to match the container's cpus (the container sees all 28 host cores, so 0 over-subscribes). GPU variant for the dev box: asr-th-en-01.gpu-dev.json.
_language_note: auto removed 2026-09-21: Whisper language detection returned 'en' (p~0.8) on every window of a real Thai meeting recording and then emitted English 'translation' hallucinations; the caller must state th/en explicitly (real-work evidence, Slice B doc §5)
_vad_note: D14 applied 2026-09-21: VAD on. Without it, silence, dither, white noise, a 440 Hz tone and 50 Hz hum were each transcribed as plausible Thai sentences and returned SUCCEEDED; with it all five return NO_SPEECH and real speech is unchanged. vad_model_sha256 pins silero_vad_v6.onnx shipped inside faster-whisper 1.2.1 (loaded locally via onnxruntime, no network). profile_revision bumped from rev-2026-09-20-large-v3-turbo so callers pinned to the old behaviour get 409.
_d10_note: revision bumped from rev-2026-09-21-large-v3-turbo-vad: moving from cuda int8_float16 to cpu int8 changes numerics, and output is already non-deterministic (D16), so callers pinned to the GPU revision get 409 rather than silently different text. Bumped again to -cpu8 when cpu_threads went from 0 to 8 (thread count changes numerics too).
